facts.text: The user wants the JSON field named FieldTypes renamed back to Constraints in the ResourceAccesses portion.
The user says none of the user accesses specify a specific resource.
The user says Resources of a resource type should not be subnodes of the AzLocalRight.
The user says resource types have AzLocalRights.
The user says AzLocalRights have FieldTypes with possible assignable fieldtypevalues.
The user says the application can have a list of resources of each type.
The user says each resource in the application list has single values for properties of their objects that match FieldTypes.
The user says the values for those properties match the FieldTypes values defined.
